Q5738.reason: Under the predominant-purpose test, the UCC governs only if the main reason for the deal was the laptop; Connie's stated purpose was the computer, so she likely prevails, though the $1,200 service price cuts against that.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and the defendant entered to have fun, forming the theft intent only after he was inside.

Q8324.reason: Chronic drug exposure typically downregulates postsynaptic dopamine receptors, which fits the craving and agitation of a drug-seeking patient, though acute withdrawal could instead reflect reduced cleft dopamine.
